summary: The orchestrator of delivery-run starts lighter: run-and-config.md keeps the core and four references are read only when their situation occurs (repo-profile.md, external-sources.md, deltas.md, tests-protocol.md), and delivery-run moves going back after a gate and external-source handling into files of its own. The test engineer writes its results as acceptance-tests.json and test-report.json, which run_state.py renders as the Markdown reports (Claude Code tells subagents not to write report Markdown, so the orchestrator used to transcribe them); run_state.py render does it for the stand-alone skills, and the review pack falls back to the JSON.
